candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory dependency, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and propagating ReadTimeout 502s up through order and gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeouts but no redis-side metrics/logs confirm the underlying cause (saturation vs network).

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, and order/gateway returning 502 ReadTimeout; topology confirms inventory->redis. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics (latency, connections, saturation) to confirm the timeout origin
Logs from inventory/redis to distinguish saturation from network fault
